mentions.name: Ardent
mentions.description: Ardent is a tool for cat breeders that supports the day-to-day work of running a breeding program. It covers weighing and health tracking, lineage and inbreeding prevention, and generates owner packs for handovers to new owners.
mentions.problem: Supporting the day-to-day concerns of breeding Ragdoll cats, such as health tracking and managing lineage to prevent inbreeding.
mentions.audience: Cat breeders, specifically the author's family who breed Ragdoll cats in the U.K.
mentions.source_excerpt: In an attempt to support what's involved in this I built Ardent for them. It covers a bunch of the day-to-day concerns (weighing and health tracking), Lineage and Inbreeding prevention, and Owner Pack generation for handovers to new Owners.

evidence.value: In an attempt to support what's involved in this I built Ardent for them. It covers a bunch of the day-to-day concerns (weighing and health tracking), Lineage and Inbreeding prevention, and Owner Pack generation for handovers to new Owners.

mentions.name: Ardent Pet
mentions.description: A website for the author's family's ragdoll cat breeding cattery in the U.K., built as a personal project to explore where LLMs are useful as coding assistants, such as front-end design and copywriting.
mentions.audience: family and folks the author cares about
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://ardent.pet/

I doubt it'll be of interest to folks here - but my Family recently (in the last couple of years) started to breed ragdoll cats in the U.K.

This has been my personal project to understand where I personally find LLMs useful as coding assistants, and where I don't.
